# Competitor Intel Brief — 2026-08-25

# Section 1 — Executive Summary

The competitive set splits cleanly into three postures: bundled water+plumbing locals (Mermaid), brand-backed manufacturers (EcoWater, and Hampton Roads leaning on "Made in USA"/Lifetime Warranty), and testing-first consultative players. Mermaid remains the sharpest direct NoVA threat this week, running four stacked promos ($200 heater, $100 first-service, free install, free flush) and leveraging 1,500+ five-star reviews plus Kinetico dealer status. No competitor is publishing actual system pricing—everyone gates cost behind a "free water test," so the real battleground is offer aggressiveness and trust signals, not price transparency. Note: 5 of the 8 promised snapshots were not included in this data pull, so this brief covers only the 3 competitors provided.

# Section 2 — Per-competitor table

| Competitor | Hero positioning (one phrase) | Distinct services | Pricing visible? | Notable shift this week |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Mermaid Water | "Clean water + dependable plumbing from a local team that tests first" | Water+plumbing bundle, pump/pressure systems, commercial (DI resin, fountains), Kinetico dealer | No — promos only ($200/$100 off, free install/flush) | No content change vs. prior snapshot; promo carousel is the persistent lever |
| EcoWater | "Better water starts here — global leader, backed by a century" | Symptom-based solution finder, smart-home leak/conserve tech, third-party certified systems | No — "free water test" gate | No change vs. prior snapshot |
| Hampton Roads Water Services | "Full-service local water quality experts — peace of mind" | Annual water test subscription, bacteria/virus treatment, air treatment, Lifetime Warranty | No — "free water test" gate | No change vs. prior snapshot |

# Section 3 — Implications for ClearWave

- **Counter Mermaid's promo stack:** They win the offer war with 4 concurrent discounts. Test a single, cleaner ClearWave offer (e.g., "$0 install + free heater flush") rather than out-discounting—simplicity converts and protects margin.
- **Borrow the "test-first, symptom-based" funnel:** Both Mermaid and EcoWater route users by problem (stains, taste, dry skin) into a free test. Build/refine a symptom-selector on our homepage that leads to a booked test—it's now table stakes in this set.
- **Attack the trust gap with proof:** Mermaid (1,500+ reviews) and Hampton Roads (Lifetime Warranty, Made in USA) lead with credibility. ClearWave should surface its strongest single trust asset above the fold and consider a matching/stronger warranty claim to neutralize Hampton Roads.

# Section 4 — Watch items

- **Get the missing 5 snapshots** — this pull only contained 3 of 8 competitors; request the rest before next week's brief.
- **Mermaid promos** — watch whether the $200/$100 offers rotate, expire, or escalate (esp. into fall/winter heater season).
- **Hampton Roads geography** — they list both Hampton Roads and Richmond numbers; monitor for expansion toward NoVA/ClearWave territory.
- **EcoWater smart-home line** — leak detection/conservation tech is a differentiator none of the locals match; watch if any local dealer starts promoting it.
